properties.name: -winui-based-on
properties.description: The WinUI Style this rule is based on (a key such as BodyTextBlockStyle): the rule's declarations are set on top of it.

properties.name: -winui-elevation
properties.description: The depth of the element's ThemeShadow, in px: a WinUI shadow that follows the theme. Units: Converted to px when building: px, rem, em, pt, pc, in, cm, mm, q. Resolved at layout, inside calc(), min(), max() or clamp(): %, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, cqw, cqh, cqi, cqb, cqmin, cqmax. No WinUI equivalent (an error): ch, ex, cap, ic, lh, rlh, rch, rex, rcap, ric, svw, svh, lvw, lvh, dvw, dvh, vi, vb.

properties.name: grid-template-columns
properties.description: WinUI: a track is auto, a length or an fr size, and they mix freely; repeat(N, ...) is expanded when building. No WinUI equivalent: repeat(auto-fill|auto-fit, ...), subgrid, masonry, named lines and % tracks (the editor's diagnostics say what to write instead).

properties.name: grid-template-rows
properties.description: WinUI: a track is auto, a length or an fr size, and they mix freely; repeat(N, ...) is expanded when building. No WinUI equivalent: repeat(auto-fill|auto-fit, ...), subgrid, masonry, named lines and % tracks (the editor's diagnostics say what to write instead).
